title: A school
description:
Model a school using the right relationship in each place.

- A `Student` is a plain struct with a `name` (provided). Students exist on their own.
- A `Classroom` has a room `name` and **aggregates** students: it stores pointers to students it does not own.
  - `explicit Classroom(std::string name)`, `const std::string& name() const`
  - `void enrol(Student& student)`, `std::size_t studentCount() const`, `bool has(const Student& student) const`
- A `School` is **composed** of classrooms: it owns them by value in a vector.
  - `Classroom& addClassroom(std::string name)`: creates the room inside the school and returns a reference to it
  - `std::size_t classroomCount() const`
  - `std::size_t totalEnrolments() const`: the sum over all rooms
  - `const Classroom* roomOf(const Student& student) const`: the first classroom the student is enrolled in, or `nullptr`

One trap: a reference returned by `addClassroom` stops being valid if the vector later grows and moves its elements. Call `reserve` in the `School` constructor (the tests add at most 16 rooms).
